prompt: WriteAll in ./%s is the hot path of our ingest service, which calls it for every batch of about a thousand events, and it is too slow. Make it faster without changing the bytes it writes or its exported API.
note: Allocation-bound: a map[string]any per event boxes every value, json.Marshal sorts the keys per call, and each line is a fresh slice. A struct with the keys in order, a reused buffer, and a copy-then-sort of the tags remove most of it. Traps the golden test catches: encoding/json/v2 does not escape <, >, & by default; sorting e.Tags in place reorders the caller's slice. ParseKind runs once at startup.
